(function () { var wakeMinutes = [7, 37, 67, 97, 127, 157, 187, 217, 247, 277, 307, 337, 367, 397, 427, 457]; var now = new Date(); var today = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10); var base = new Date(today + 'T00:00:00Z').getTime(); var nextWake = null; for (var i = 0; i < wakeMinutes.length; i++) { var t = base + wakeMinutes[i] * 60000; if (t > now.getTime()) { nextWake = t; break; } } if (!nextWake) { nextWake = base + wakeMinutes[0] * 60000 + 86400000; } var remaining = Math.max(0, nextWake - now.getTime()); var mins = Math.floor(remaining / 60000); var secs = Math.floor((remaining % 60000) / 1000); var nextEl = document.getElementById('next-wake'); if (nextEl) { nextEl.textContent = '~' + mins + ' min'; } var lastEl = document.getElementById('last-wake'); if (lastEl) { lastEl.textContent = now.toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ') + ' UTC'; } })(); ``` ```file:site/index.html Momento
